Job Title: Copilot Studio / Agentic AI Engineer
Level: Mid-Senior to Senior
Function: AI Automation Engineering
Employment Type: Full-Time
Purpose
Build the first 5 6 Copilot Studio agents and continue scaling additional agents within the Microsoft ecosystem.
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Copilot Studio / Agentic AI Engineer to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade AI agents within the Microsoft ecosystem. This role focuses on developing the initial set of production-ready Copilot Studio agents and supporting the broader rollout of intelligent AI-driven solutions.
You will work at the intersection of Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic orchestration, enterprise automation, and workflow intelligence to create scalable AI solutions that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Build and enhance Microsoft Copilot Studio agents
Work with LLMs, agentic workflows, and autonomous AI actions
Develop intelligent agents within the Microsoft ecosystem
Integrate agents with enterprise systems using Power Automate and APIs
Support iterative rollout, testing, optimization, and scaling of AI agents
Design reusable agentic workflows and orchestration patterns
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into AI-driven solutions
Improve agent performance, prompt quality, and workflow efficiency
Stay updated with Microsoft AI ecosystem advancements and Copilot Studio capabilities


Required Skills
Microsoft Ecosystem Experience
Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, Azure, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, and Power Platform
Copilot Studio Expertise
Hands-on experience building agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio
LLM / Agentic Workflow Experience
Experience with LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, and autonomous workflows
Power Automate Experience
Strong experience creating cloud flows, integrations, connectors, approvals, and workflow automation


Preferred Skills
Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Services
Semantic Kernel or Copilot SDK exposure
Power Apps Dataverse
Prompt Engineering
API Integrations
CI/CD and Power Platform ALM
Multi-agent orchestration patterns
Python or JavaScript for custom plugins/connectors


What We re Looking For
4 8 years of overall technology experience
Strong problem-solving and AI automation mindset
Ability to work in fast-paced, evolving AI environments
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Experience working in Agile delivery models
Strong ownership mindset with focus on scalable, production-grade AI solutions


Nice to Have
Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility experience
Enterprise AI governance exposure
Experience in regulated industries
Knowledge of multi-agent communication and delegation workflows






Location: Remote
Experience :4-8
